proofOrder: Validate source claims through Arq Language System 4.1.
Build the exact static artifact with SITE_BASE_PATH=/Arq and SITE_ORIGIN=https://ruddvz.github.io.
Run rendered-artifact route and phrase verification before upload.
Deploy the artifact through the protected Pages workflow.
Verify the deployed route set and commit-bound proof after deployment.
requiredProperties: A claim scanner must run before any context-refresh command.
Route coverage must include every public source route and the 404 page.
The deployed proof must record the commit and artifact identity.
An unresolved conflict-registry record prohibits a promotional current-tense claim.
A local journal, native .arq file, and compatible-but-not-opened file state must not be collapsed in public copy.
